verdict.rationale: AngelList documents the pieces of this workflow. Founders can request 409A valuations (Equity > Valuations), generate board consents and collect signatures on-platform, and use board-pre-approved Equity Blocks for standard grants. Grants are then e-signed by company and recipient, the cap table updates automatically, and recipients accept via e-signature. However, nothing shows the 409A valuation automatically setting the grant's strike price or these steps running as one connected flow. The update FAQ also points customers to other cap table providers, which raises questions about the product's continuity. missing for 10: documented linkage of the 409A valuation to the option strike price, explicit single end-to-end grant workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration, clarity on whether Stack Equity is still offered.
